name: element
title: Wrap DOM Element
description: Wraps the selected DOM element/subtree in a new native wrapper element with optional class and data-area.

settings.name: component
settings.title: Component
settings.description: Optional React component name used to resolve its source file and scope edits to that component.

settings.name: file
settings.title: File
settings.description: Optional source file. May be absolute or project-relative.

settings.name: path
settings.title: Path
settings.description: Optional project-relative source file path alias.

settings.name: seat_id
settings.title: Construction Seat ID
settings.description: Optional exact data-rab-seat address for the DOM target. This is an internal construction address; human requests may resolve to it semantically.

settings.name: data_area
settings.title: Data Area
settings.description: Optional data-area value identifying the source DOM target.

settings.name: element
settings.title: DOM Element
settings.description: Optional native DOM element name identifying the source target.

settings.name: quantifier
settings.title: How Many
settings.description: Defaults to one target. Use all to edit every matching target where supported.

settings.name: wrapper_tag
settings.title: Wrapper Tag
settings.description: Native wrapper tag. Defaults to div.

settings.name: class_name
settings.title: Wrapper Class
settings.description: Optional class token(s) on the wrapper.

settings.name: new_data_area
settings.title: Wrapper Data Area
settings.description: Optional data-area value on the wrapper.

settings.name: new_seat_id
settings.title: New Construction Seat ID
settings.description: Optional data-rab-seat address to place on the new/wrapper element so later Tools can target it exactly.

settings.name: dry_run
settings.title: Preview Only
settings.description: Return the deterministic edit plan without writing the file.
